KAIA, our AI assistant , drafts the policies, checks the evidence, and monitors the controls, eliminating roughly 80% of manual work . 400+ customers, including Personio, Enpal, Flink, and Blacklane use Kertos. Every audit with us has been successful. A powerhouse of 75+ people in Munich and Berlin and a €14M Series A behind us. We are hiring for what comes next! Your purpose at Kertos You’ll be an essential part of our internal IT team and ensure that everyone at Kertos can work smoothly. Our team is growing rapidly, new employees, new tools, new devices and you’ll keep everything organized. You’ll be the first point of contact when something isn’t working, and you’ll actively help ensure that our IT infrastructure scales with us. IT Administration: You’ll keep our IT processes organized and well-documented, so we can maintain a clear overview even as we continue to grow. The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring You’re available for a long-term position as a working student and can commit to 15–20 hours per week with us. You can independently prioritize multiple concurrent requests, remain reliable, and find pragmatic solutions. You have an affinity for startups, enjoy pitching in, and communicate openly; German language skills are a plus, but not required. You’re interested in cybersecurity and would like to learn about topics such as MDM configuration or endpoint security (e.g., CrowdStrike). You have already worked with ticketing systems, MDM solutions, or similar IT tools. You’re curious about how a fast-growing team functions internally and are eager to actively help shape its structures. items.snippet: UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen. Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerker:innen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen. Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen. DEINE MISSION BEI UNS Als Team Lead Customer Support (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Customer Support Teams. Du baust einen skalierbaren, AI-gestützten und datengetriebenen Support auf, der unseren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Serviceerlebnis bietet. Dabei verbindest du operatives Tagesgeschäft mit strategischer Weiterentwicklung, optimierst Prozesse und förderst dein Team gezielt in seiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung. Mit smarten Automatisierungen, klaren KPIs und einem starken Team schaffst du die Grundlage dafür, unseren Customer Support nachhaltig zu skalieren. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Du führst, coachst und entwickelst unsere Customer Support Specialists weiter – mit regelmäßigem Feedback und gezielten Trainings begleitest du sie auf ihrem Weg vom Junior zum Mid-Level und Senior. Du verantwortest das operative Tagesgeschäft im Support und stellst sicher, dass Tickets effizient zugewiesen, priorisiert und gemäß unseren SLAs und Qualitätsstandards bearbeitet werden. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Eskalationen und komplexe Kundenanfragen und übernimmst selbst anspruchsvolle oder dringende Supportfälle. Du analysierst und optimierst relevante Support-KPIs wie Erreichbarkeit, Antwort- und Lösungszeiten, Ticket-Backlog und Kundenzufriedenheit. Du optimierst die Einsatzplanung, Aufgabenverteilung und Supportprozesse, um die Kundenerreichbarkeit zu steigern. Du treibst unseren AI-gestützten First-Level-Support voran – mit dem Ziel einen großen Teil der eingehenden Tickets automatisiert zu lösen, ohne Abstriche bei der Servicequalität zu machen. Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale im Team und verbesserst die Performance durch gezieltes Coaching, Qualitätskontrollen und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche. Du entwickelst unsere Knowledge Base kontinuierlich weiter und stellst sicher, dass Hilfeartikel und Supportressourcen aktuell, verständlich und relevant bleiben. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Customer Success zusammen, um die Supportstrategie weiterzuentwickeln, KPIs wöchentlich zu überprüfen und operative Verbesserungen umzusetzen. Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit RevOps, Customer Success und Product zusammen, um Kundenfeedback einzubringen, wiederkehrende Probleme zu lösen und weitere AI-Automatisierungspotenziale zu identifizieren. DEIN PROFIL Must-haves Du bringst Erfahrung in der Führung eines Customer Support Teams mit, idealerweise als Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsrolle. Du hast Erfahrung im People Management und Coaching und weißt, wie du Mitarbeitende gezielt förderst und in ihrer Karriereentwicklung begleitest. Du kennst dich mit Customer Support Prozessen, SLA-Management, Performance-KPIs und Qualitätssicherung aus. Du überzeugst durch klare Kommunikation, analytisches Denken und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. items.title: Data Engineer Intern
items.snippet: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers. items.snippet: Opening WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP Details Preferred starting date: ASAP Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week) Period: 6 months About the company Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety. Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering. We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment. Your role You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include: Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware What we expect from you Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization) Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA) Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome) Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer vision. Because our graphics work is tightly coupled with our perception stack, strong vision fundamentals will let you have an even bigger impact: Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation General Full-time availability during the internship period. A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge. A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work. What can we offer 1000 euro monthly compensation. 10 vacation days during internship period. (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week. Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products. The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected. Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build. The application procedure If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills. We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow. If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period). Welcome to the team!
